name: run a provided test runner and interpret its results report for self-verification
definition: Execute the bundled node runner that evaluates the solution on multiple trial maps and produces a JSON results file; read the results to gauge success and turn counts.
failure_mode: Solution causes the runner to error or the results file is absent/malformed.

name: self-signed TLS certificate for a local HTTPS service
definition: Generate a self-signed certificate for the required subject/validity, serve local content over HTTPS on a resolvable hostname, and persist a verification string/printout of subject/validity/fingerprint.
failure_mode: TLS is not served, the certificate does not validate, or the HTTPS endpoint is unreachable.

name: serialize flows as binary netflow v5 export datagrams
definition: pack each orchestrated export as a binary NetFlow v5 export datagram with the version-5 header fields (version, timestamp, uptime, sequence) and the standard flow field layout including switched-count fields.
failure_mode: a wrong header version/field layout causes parse to fail or produce wrong timestamps

name: serve a kv store as a live grpc server
definition: implement a server class in a file and keep it serving on the agreed port while the tests run
failure_mode: server not running, wrong port, or half-implemented rpc body breaks the round-trip checks
